summary: Browse and read books from your calibre-web library.
page_description: Browse a public or private OPDS library, download EPUBs and continue reading offline.
release_notes: Browse real library catalogs, sign in on the reader, download EPUBs and keep reading offline with save recovery.

steps.text: Add the HTTPS OPDS address of your calibre-web or calibre content-server library.
Choose Sign in on the reader for a private library, or Use public library. Older named accounts should sign in again to bind the account to this server.
For a private certificate authority, install its trust root separately.

user: Somebody with a calibre-web library who wants it on their Kobo.
job: Browse your calibre-web library and read its books on e-ink.
offline: Books already fetched and your reading places work without the network; browsing the library does not.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; they are how the app reaches your library

data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; the originals stay in your calibre-web library

data.kind: your reading place in each fetched book
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; it exists so a half-read book continues

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to reach your calibre-web library and fetch its books

non_goals: It does not edit your library.
It does not sync reading places back to calibre-web.
